thread:
kara: Tiny life update: I accepted Staff PM 🎉 and we're expecting a baby in October 👶✨. Doing a low-key shower at the office next week if folks want to swing by. No gifts pls, card only ❤️
alex: HUGE congrats Kara!! Staff PM energy + baby = unstoppable. When's the office thing?
kara: Thinking Wed 12:30 in the SF kitchen. 20 min, cake + mocktails. No pressure to stay long.
priya: omg congrats!! I can bring a card and sign a group gift if people want to chip in. budget $15-30?
jonathan: congrats!! I'll handle coffee + a savory option (mini quiches?) Also vote: cake vs scones?
meera: cake for the win. but if scones show up I won’t complain. gluten-free option pls.
rachel: I'll add a tiny banner and bring candles (battery only). Can someone do a short photo?
alex: I can be official photographer and embarrass Kara with baby pics later :camera_with_flash:
priya: quick poll: group card or virtual card? both?
kara: both is fine but seriously no big gifts. your presence and coffee are gift enough.
events-bot: Event created: "Kara: Staff PM + Baby Shower" Wed 12:30pm SF kitchen. RSVP by Tue.
jonathan: RSVP'd. sending confetti. :confetti_ball:
meera: ditto. congrats again Kara!! :tada:
kara: thanks everyone. you all make this so easy to be excited. <3
